qualified.pointMeaning: Representative point of surviving curved amphitheatre seating footprint, not park centre or an invented entrance.
qualified.proof: Original operator map #8 identifies Théâtre d’Homère as amphitheatre at lake edge; historical inventory describes this Roman-style amphitheatre. 2020 press photograph and 2026 aerial show surviving curved lake-edge seating and stage. OSM way58112241 is the exact curved seating footprint (cadastre2010); stage is adjacent way58112242. Matched manually against photographs and lake/bridge geometry. Coordinates rounded to six decimals from seating footprint representative centre. No claim that show still operates.
